profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Full-Stack Developer focused on bringing ideas to life with Vue.js, Laravel, and Tailwind.
I thrive in roles where I can design, refine, and elevate user experiences—not just make features work, but make them delightful. With several years of experience building dynamic applications, I take pride in writing clean code, solving problems efficiently, and creating UI that people enjoy using. I’m driven, detail-oriented, and always leveling up.

Alongside my technical work, I’ve spent years serving my community through coaching and volunteer involvement, which has strengthened my communication, leadership, and mentoring skills. I love contributing to teams, supporting others, and building products that make people’s lives easier.

volunteerExperiences.description: Leading a group of students on the weekend at the preschool age. Leading a small group of high school girls on Wednesday nights. Helping them work through problems and guide their faith.
Aided a Urban Venture Teacher in tutoring bilingual students in English as well as explaining in Spanish. Aided with math, reading, and science.
